doc_mentions.claim: On recent systems the positron service sets the number of hugepages after boot. Set POS_NR_HUGEPAGES to the number of hugepages per NUMA node, for example 48 on a 2-node system for 96 in total.

Design doc: POS_NR_HUGEPAGES overrides the startup hugepage budget with an absolute count. The default is default_n_hugepages = 16.
Design doc: the nr_hugepages stat matches the --nr_hugepages option, the n_hugepages global and the POS_NR_HUGEPAGES variable. The budget is fixed at startup.
Design doc table: "Hugepage count, production: POS_NR_HUGEPAGES = 48".
Design doc: set POS_NR_HUGEPAGES=20 for the STORY-425 validation workload. Lines 17, 948 and 1057 repeat the value 20. Line 472 lists the variable as one source of the budget.
Design doc: an MMLU run reached out-of-memory at POS_NR_HUGEPAGES=80. The same run completed with RZ_KV_CACHE_GB=24.
